question: Rann Utsav promotes natural beauty and other famous traveling places of the stunning zone of _________ During the full moon nights in the winter season, the white sand desert looks more mesmerizing.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Kutch.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rann Utsav is a vibrant **cultural festival **celebrated in the Rann of Kutch, located in the **western state of Gujarat**, India. 
 
• This annual festival, which usually takes place from **November to February**, promotes the natural beauty, culture, and heritage of the Kutch region.
 
• The Rann of Kutch is famous for its striking **white salt flats** stretching over **7,500 square kilometers.** 
 
• The festival offers an opportunity to indulge in authentic **Kutchi cuisine, including delicacies such as dabeli, kadhi-khichdi, bajra no rotlo, and chaas (buttermilk).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Kala Dungar**: Known as the Black Hill, it is the **highest point in Kutch **and offers stunning panoramic views of the Great Rann of Kutch.
 
• **Dholavira**: An ancient site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, offering a glimpse into one of the oldest urban settlements in the world.
